name: electrobun-vue
description: Electrobun app with Vue and Vite HMR

scripts.dev:hmr: bun run build:view && concurrently --kill-others --names vite,electrobun "bun run hmr" "wait-on --timeout 30000 http://localhost:5173 && electrobun dev"
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:app && bun run typecheck:bun && bun run typecheck:build
scripts.build:dev: bun run typecheck && bun run build:view && electrobun build --env=dev
scripts.build:canary: bun run typecheck && bun run build:view && electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:stable: bun run typecheck && bun run build:view && electrobun build --env=stable
